PHILOSOPHY's front, 'The ethics, from continuation', at the dossier's depth of the first screen's anchor. Self-concern is defined, with one's own continuation read as what lies within the center's reach. The ranking is on a finite listing and, with admission decided, between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list. The course of a line that persists without end never fits such a list, so there this route is silent. The condition read in time holds only from some step on. Seeing is needed for a choice to answer to a loss, and not enough. C is said with every claim counted as living, and P-07 gives its general form with `living`.

PHILOSOPHY P-13: route (b)'s 'reason of its own' is said with 07's condition (the represented boundary matching what the center depends on). It adds that reach is not a proof that a particular loss comes back in time and size, and that self-concern gives no verdict where keeping one thing closes another (astra's seventh-pass finding 2, applied to the dossier's own paraphrase).

PHILOSOPHY P-16 and ALIGNMENT A-16: the condition in time (07 §4.11) with its four laws, and the statement that no theorem composes the in-time condition with self-concern. P-17 and A-16 give the one-center result with what it counts on a net going forward in time, and that two centers can meet it over what comes after.
